metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Neon Script Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring a central subject with a vibrant, glowing neon heart and script overlay on the lower foreground.
triggerTerms: black and white photo with blue and pink neon
excludeWhen: minimalist flat design without lighting effects is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered black and white headshot of a woman with wavy blonde hair, framed against a solid black background, featuring a luminous neon heart and cursive text in the lower third that casts a colored glow onto the subject's skin.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. vibrant neon overlay
Soft hair texture vs. sharp neon light lines
Central eye-level gaze vs. lower-third graphic anchor
Solid black background vs. high-key blonde hair highlights
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white processing for the subject
Neon glow effect casting light onto the subject's arm/chest
Solid black negative space surrounding the head and shoulders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders filling the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing neon heart and script in the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the neon graphic, then follows the hair curves back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background provides high contrast for the blonde hair and neon glow.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the neon elements against zero saturation in the portrait.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders to mimic light trails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style paired with a geometric heart shape.
graphicDevices: Neon heart outline with a 'tail' flourish

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the personal, informal feel of the lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with wavy blonde hair against a black background, leaving the lower chest area clear for an overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a glowing neon heart in pink and a cursive script in electric blue over the lower center, ensuring the neon light 'spills' onto the subject's skin.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait strictly black and white?
Does the neon have a white core with a colored outer glow?
Is there visible light spill from the neon onto the subject?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Muddy gray tones in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between hair and background
Verify neon glow interaction with skin
Ensure script is legible despite the glow
recipe.reuseFormula: Black and white portrait + [Color A] neon shape + [Color B] neon script overlay.
